Brittany believes that equipping our communities and workplaces with lifesaving tools will help confront the opioid epidemic and save lives. She also introduced the bipartisan Natural Disaster Property Protection Act , a bill that would ease the barriers that homeowners and business owners face when preparing their properties for natural disasters. This bill will allow Coloradans to better prepare for wildfires or extreme weather by cutting down on the bureaucracy and red tape that comes with protecting property. In addition, Brittany has been working across the aisle to put forward a framework for averting a GOP-driven government shutdown — a completely manufactured crisis that would only harm our country. Finally, Brittany traveled across the district this month to meet with local leaders and discuss the issues that are impacting Colorado communities. From a roundtable in Golden on violence prevention to a town hall on extreme weather in Buena Vista, Brittany will always put local communities first. | | |

# We Missed the Debate
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Friends, I’ve got some bad news. We didn’t qualify for this month’s GOP presidential debate. That means that there will be no candidates on that debate stage promoting an America First agenda. **But we’re not giving up.** We know the RNC is out of step with the American people. After all, Donald Trump was a longshot presidential candidate in 2015, and he went on to win the GOP nomination and the White House! When we take our message directly to the American people, there’s nothing that can stop us. **To do that, we need your help. We need to raise $55,000 to meet our third quarter fundraising goals, and that deadline is at the end of this week.** [**Can I count on you to help us bridge the gap? Any amount helps us take our America First message directly to the American people.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=13c81c83bf&e=0be619cbaa) Our American restoration campaign is just beginning. I’ve toured this great country, and I’ve spoken to thousands of Americans who are sick and tired of a Republican Party that’s unwilling to confront the issues that matter most to them. **Here’s the bottom line: If we don’t advance bold solutions, we will lose, and the Democrats will move forward with the same disastrous policies that ruined my home state of California.** Your financial support keeps us in the fight, funding our grassroots efforts and our advertising campaigns. It also sends a message to the career politicians and the RNC: We the People refuse to be ignored. [**So I’m asking, give whatever you can TODAY to make sure that our America First campaign continues to grow. We can’t count on the political establishment. Patriotic Americans must stand up and take our country back.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=e40d70a907&e=0be619cbaa) Thanks,
Larry Elder
GOP Candidate for President

clean_body: | | | | Peter, I want to take a moment to tell you about one of the most humbling experiences of my life. In 2018, I ran for the Oregon House of Representatives in District 51. I was just a wife, mom, and small businesswoman who dreamed of serving her community to the best of her ability. I was running to help keep Oregon and America safe for our families. They threw everything they had at me, and in the end, lost to my far-Left opponent—but that didn’t stop me. I don’t believe in giving up. I’d made it that far with hard work and determination and wouldn’t quit. I was more motivated than ever. In 2022, I gave everything I had to defeat the Leftist machine and despite MILLIONS in spending against me, we won. Together, we flipped a DEEP BLUE seat RED and I became the first Hispanic woman to serve Oregon in Congress. This was and still is a HUGE victory. We need to continue to keep up the fight and defy the odds to save our seat and the majority. But I won’t lie to you—the Democrats are still furious that we flipped the seat Red, and will do ANYTHING to take back OR-05 in 2024. The GOP House Majority runs through Oregon and if we lose our seat, we lose the House Majority. | This is why I need your help today, Peter. | This race won’t be easy, and I need all the help I can get to defend my seat and take on Joe Biden’s machine. Thank you, Lori Chavez-DeRemer Congresswoman OR-05 | | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. | | Dear Peter,

Yesterday, WAGOP Chairman Jim Walsh sent you a list of 37 school board races that pundits are referring to as "bellwether" elections in Washington State this year. The results in these races will be one measure of the movement our Party is making in key geographical areas, with specific voting blocs.

**This**** ****isn****’t a complete list****of recommended****or endorsed school board candidates.** It’s a **leading indicator** of what we can expect heading into the 2024 statewide races. **Good results in these 37 races means our common-sense conservative message and ground game strategy are working**.

These bellwether races are listed below, arranged by county location—so you can find the races closest to you. **Click on the buttons below to** **learn more about these important campaigns** either from their campaign website, or from the county GOP website (not all local campaigns have campaign websites). You’ll find **candidate information, campaign event schedules, volunteer opportunities, and contribution** links.
_**Please also look on your county GOP website for voting recommendations in your hometown.**_

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:**
September 27, 2023
Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com)
**“Chris Christie Is Again The Debate's Straight Talker” Statement from TILII PAC Chair Bill Palatucci**
**ARLINGTON, VA —** Bill Palatucci, Chairman of Tell It Like It Is PAC, issued the following statement after the second Republican presidential debate held at the Ronald Reagan Presidential Foundation and Institute:
“Once again, Chris Christie was the only candidate on the debate stage willing to answer every question - directly and without putting his finger in the air to test the political winds. The Governor is the only candidate tonight warning Republicans of the pending electoral disaster next November if we nominate the former President with his four indictments, distractions and drama. Can't wait to see him with President Trump on the debate stage in Miami on November 8th."
Below is a sampling of what others are saying about Chris Christie’s debate performance:
[Robert Doar, President of AEI](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=365fc68b76&e=d0a9afa930): Best answer of the night so far from @ChrisChristie
[Rich Lowry, National Review](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=04b315fa7c&e=d0a9afa930): Finally someone hits Trump for not showing up
[Ellen Carmichael](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=625bd50ed6&e=d0a9afa930): Reagan Library explodes in applause when Christie calls out Trump for not being on the stage tonight.
[Rebeccah Heinrichs, Hudson Institute](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=a269d6af32&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie is right on Russia-China.
[Heath Mayo, Principles First](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=a504e31594&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie with the best answer of the night in my book—on foreign policy. Vision, passion, strategy and courage, all in one. Weaken the Sino-Russian alliance on all fronts. An answer worthy of Reagan’s shadow.
[Frank Luntz](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=d109331712&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie is clearly appealing to the ‘peace through strength’ crowd. And his straight-to-camera appeal makes it powerful. #GOPDebate
[Ellen Carmichael](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=cb99eefa86&e=d0a9afa930): Say what you will about Chris Christie, he's unafraid of anyone or anything.
[S.E. Cupp](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=525f88c552&e=d0a9afa930): "This public school system is no longer run by the public, it's run by the teachers unions." -- Chris Christie #GOPDebate
[Townhall](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=b3792a9914&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie slams Joe Biden for "sleeping with a member of a teacher's union."
[Republicans Against Trump](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=def84226d6&e=d0a9afa930): “You’re not here tonight because you're afraid to defend your record. You’re ducking...We’re going to call you Donald Duck.”
[Philip Wegmann, RealClearPolitics](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=7b6bba93aa&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie says when "we have the president of the United States sleeping with a member of the teachers union" the White House is advocating "every day for the worst of their teachers."
[Hugo Lowell, The Guardian](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=6e63492987&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie with the best answer of the night — degrading Russia’s military thru Ukraine aid bc Putin wants to bring back the Soviet Union
[Heath Mayo, Principles First](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=af77255a94&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie has the most presidential moments of anyone on the stage. By far. That answer on being pro-life for the whole life was presidential.
[Philip Wegmann, RealClearPolitics](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=5e838a7247&e=d0a9afa930): "If you're pro life, you've gotta be pro-life for the entire life," Christie says citing need to care also for the "drug-addicted 16 year-old on the floor of the county lockup."
[Geraldo Rivera](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=644d77360e&e=d0a9afa930): Chris Christie is toughest, best vs Trump...
_If you liked what you saw tonight, make sure to make a donation of just $1 to keep Chris Christie on the debate stage in Miami on November 8. He’s the only candidate unafraid to tell the truth and hold Trump accountable._

subject: Milton Friedman: What does “created equal” mean?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.

| | | | [](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
| | Hi Friend,One of the reasons young people are so attracted to the idea of socialism is the promised equality of outcomes.

They want life to be fair for everyone, and for all to have wellness, happiness, and financial security. But if the end goal of socialism is “equality”, that begs the question: what is equality? Are equality and liberty consistent one with the other or are they in conflict?
---
| [](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
| | In this **[](http://trk.readactnews.)[25-page commentary](http://trk.readactnews.)** , "Created Equal", legendary economist and Hoover fellow Milton Friedman answers these and other questions in great depth. You’ll learn what Thomas Jefferson meant when he wrote the words “created equal” in the Declaration of Independence and how the meaning has changed through American history. You’ll see how Friedman brilliantly illustrates differences between equality of opportunity and equality of outcome.

With many today striving to increase government power in the name of a concept of “equality”, Friedman’s words still ring true for those who believe that a society that puts freedom first will end up with both greater freedom and greater equality.

_**No apologies.**_
Fellow American,

Another debate, _another victory_. This campaign's momentum is truly catching fire and shows just how much Americans are ready for real change.

Tonight, I was once again the number one target of my fellow Republican candidates. Nikki Haley said she felt "dumber" when I spoke. Tim Scott came after my business record. Ron DeSantis' Super PAC wouldn't stop tweeting about me.

While they launched their attacks on my platform last night, I focused on the TRUTH.

**If the establishment means to have a war,_let it begin here._**

On foreign policy, there's no difference between Joe Biden or anyone else on this stage. If you want 20 more years of no-win wars that don't advance our interests, then I'm not your guy. If you want to stay out of foreign wars and make America stronger at home, I know how to get that done.

**Here's another TRUTH:** we are going to Shut. It. Down. body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23329%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fSqMxou4PFz3Vnb%2b4vEzzA&sysid=1)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you’d like to give online, here’s a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23320%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kxnWBBBhUVb5mXDUsjhgxA&sysid=1)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity’s show that I’ve partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I’m the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left’s cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America’s freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that’s when you know you’re saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America’s founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23321%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ub5sxU72qd%2fQvSGbW8A4lQ&sysid=1)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23322%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SGzEPYS%2fpDAnasrBP8cZug&sysid=1)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---

# Abortion in Nevada
---
Last year I spoke at the Women's Chamber of Commerce in Las Vegas. After my comments, people were invited to ask questions. One woman said, "We should have a statute in Nevada protecting a woman's right to have an abortion." I was a little surprised that she didn't know that Nevada does have just such a law. Here is my response: "Nevada does have a statute giving women the right to an abortion. In fact, it was passed by a referendum of the people. This means the law cannot be overturned by the Governor or by the legislature. Only the people of Nevada can change it. In Nevada, women may have an abortion, for any reason or no reason at all, through the 24th week of pregnancy. Even after that, women can have an abortion to protect the life and health of the mother. Nevada is a pro-choice State." Upon further reflection, I wish I had said more about abortion in Nevada. I wish I had also said: I am unapologetically pro-life. I think we should protect the life of an unborn child. I believe a woman should have a choice whether she engages in activities that can lead to pregnancy. When a woman doesn't have a choice, such as in the case of rape or incest, then I support an exception. I also support exceptions to protect the life and health of the mother. I support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe vs Wade, not just because I'm pro-life, but because it is the correct legal decision. Even Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg stated the Roe decision was on shaky legal ground. There is nothing in the Constitution guaranteeing a right to abortion. When the Constitution is silent on a topic the power is vested in the States and in "We, the people." As your representative in Congress, I will not support any federal action that goes against the will of the people of my district. Like 71% of Americans, the people of Nevada think there should be limits on abortion. In Nevada, those limits are 24 weeks and then the life and health of the mother. Dina Titus is ignoring the will of the people. She voted to remove all limits. She voted to allow abortion until the day of delivery in the 9th month of pregnancy. That's not all. She voted to have the government pay for these unlimited abortions. That's right; she took the extreme position that 71% of Americans, who believe we should have limits on abortion, should be forced to pay for unlimited abortions. In the coming days leading up to the elections, you will hear Titus and others talk about abortion. They will bring it up because they don't want you thinking about inflation, the border crisis, crime, or our failing schools. Remember, the people of Nevada have already spoken on abortion - it is settled law. When career politicians in Nevada bring up abortion, they are just trying to divert your attention from their disastrous policies which have devastated our economy. Don't let them get away with it!
---
Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: What can be done to reduce the high cost of healthcare? -E.V. A. I will support legislation that gives Americans more choices in their healthcare and insurance options. Currently, there is proposed legislation working its way through Congress that would expand options for high-deductible plans that have low monthly premiums. I am interested in learning more about it.
Q. I recently learned that Nevada ranks first in human trafficking. What can be done? -B.W. A. First, we need to secure the border and control ports of entry. Second, we must aggressively pursue and prosecute those involved in this evil practice. Third, as individuals, we must support charitable organizations which provide a way out for those trapped in these circumstances.

clean_body: Mark's Monday Memo | | | | Abortion in Nevada Last year I spoke at the Women's Chamber of Commerce in Las Vegas. After my comments, people were invited to ask questions. One woman said, "We should have a statute in Nevada protecting a woman's right to have an abortion." I was a little surprised that she didn't know that Nevada does have just such a law. Here is my response: "Nevada does have a statute giving women the right to an abortion. In fact, it was passed by a referendum of the people. This means the law cannot be overturned by the Governor or by the legislature. Only the people of Nevada can change it. In Nevada, women may have an abortion, for any reason or no reason at all, through the 24th week of pregnancy. Even after that, women can have an abortion to protect the life and health of the mother. Nevada is a pro-choice State." Upon further reflection, I wish I had said more about abortion in Nevada. I wish I had also said: I am unapologetically pro-life. I think we should protect the life of an unborn child. I believe a woman should have a choice whether she engages in activities that can lead to pregnancy. When a woman doesn't have a choice, such as in the case of rape or incest, then I support an exception. I also support exceptions to protect the life and health of the mother. I support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe vs Wade, not just because I'm pro-life, but because it is the correct legal decision. Even Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg stated the Roe decision was on shaky legal ground. There is nothing in the Constitution guaranteeing a right to abortion. When the Constitution is silent on a topic the power is vested in the States and in "We, the people." As your representative in Congress, I will not support any federal action that goes against the will of the people of my district. Like 71% of Americans, the people of Nevada think there should be limits on abortion. In Nevada, those limits are 24 weeks and then the life and health of the mother. Dina Titus is ignoring the will of the people. She voted to remove all limits. She voted to allow abortion until the day of delivery in the 9th month of pregnancy. That's not all. She voted to have the government pay for these unlimited abortions. That's right; she took the extreme position that 71% of Americans, who believe we should have limits on abortion, should be forced to pay for unlimited abortions. In the coming days leading up to the elections, you will hear Titus and others talk about abortion. They will bring it up because they don't want you thinking about inflation, the border crisis, crime, or our failing schools. Remember, the people of Nevada have already spoken on abortion - it is settled law. When career politicians in Nevada bring up abortion, they are just trying to divert your attention from their disastrous policies which have devastated our economy. Don't let them get away with it! Your Questions--Mark's Answers Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently: Q: What can be done to reduce the high cost of healthcare? -E.V. A. I will support legislation that gives Americans more choices in their healthcare and insurance options. Currently, there is proposed legislation working its way through Congress that would expand options for high-deductible plans that have low monthly premiums. I am interested in learning more about it. Q. I recently learned that Nevada ranks first in human trafficking. What can be done? -B.W. A. First, we need to secure the border and control ports of entry. Second, we must aggressively pursue and prosecute those involved in this evil practice. Third, as individuals, we must support charitable organizations which provide a way out for those trapped in these circumstances. Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Securing the Border shouldn't be taboo and fighting off criminals with no care for human life isn't evil. But our Democratic leadership chooses to look the other way because solving the problem won't line their pockets.
ENOUGH IS ENOUGH!
I have proven through my public service record that I will be a front-line fighter to secure Nevada's borders, cut through the incompetent bureaucracy and face the rampant crime head-on!
In less than 48 hours, we have the opportunity to send a powerful message to the political elites in our nation's capital.

## GOP Debate Roundup
Seven Republican presidential candidates [sparred last night](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2O4yAUQOGngY6IXP5MQbGNu2y7pXUDF8MuNpaNEuXtVzP11Kc40vfnsTywtrqvv3GjMHJfMI76okV6AZMAtQBPIRMBKU7hbr3xUt2t4iW4lI1J6oneRqNRmxg1kLcTAVrrJ14DSFDSwyS9Ucbd7KTAZaUVyhytI6YlpTr6efvb6z4K5fbpLzpvsW-8hTLGcTH1i8HMYB6FSm3tqzGYS99op_fFYI64HVjXncGsAZwCJ3J9kRj4j_CNn0vks29iFBIXxb4nsfZDJHriIAYzP0M63rW1elnHtFw3rN8XPn4G-R8AAP__Uo9hrA) in an event that was, like the first debate, overshadowed by former President Trump's notable absence.

Trump was still speaking to striking auto workers in Michigan as the other candidates began trading barbs in Simi Valley, and several took newly aggresive lines toward the former President. "_He should be on this stage tonight,_ " Ron DeSantis said, along with criticism of the Trump administration's addition to the national debt.

Several candidates attacked Ramaswamy for his business dealings in China and use of TikTok, and Nikki Haley and Tim Scott squared off over tax policy.

DeSantis received praise in [post-debate spin](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FugzAQQL_GbEbOnQ148NCFLV07osOck6scjMAN7d9X6dzx6Q1P7-M6XUmyrLd3enCoqUwUqzx5Ml7DoAEnaJaQmIGx4XDpvPMGLx029-BnhzPx4IES2mjIorFpMDa6PtLsGglgAI2HwXiHrm-7AaFPaJFMil3PyhpepJa9_Syy1jun_FOevLexPJoc7rVuh8I3BaOC8TzPNpXvlc_j5RWMWZ6sX6xgvJVN77x9zVkirXrb-ZCF1yqU9cIzVW72sGyn5CxH1ytrbg-S_Feq_4__BgAA__8P6ltO) for his "presidential" performance, and he is the only candidate besides Trump polling in the double digits, although he still trails the former president by a [huge margin](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO3CAQxvGnwd1aeMDYFBRp3G3alIjFw3qiMViYXStvH91Jd9W1n37Fp_-fu78HYsrP32FH11LxITZ6o5f2BvMNlIdudQkRUHXoBmNHK9VgVLe5pEOaH-NqzDQaiFoPqMEiyqSGyZq5IwcSlLQwSzuqcerNrGBKSqsgUzQTCi1xpVZq_7dQbhsm_lfeWPtY9o7d1tpxCvVLwCJgua6rrxg4MoZ6FKZG8fyQAhY8CvMpYAEJWsByVDxpxdwELK-v3Vc8Xg-mGLL_BhTY57JTDo1Kvk2jnvut7dxVtx4XMdNpJqHlcw_En7_az5n-BwAA__81S2oG).
## Target to Shut Down Nine Stores in Big Cities
Target says it will close nine stores in major cities [due to crime and violence](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL-OtCAUxZ8GOwxeFKWg-Bq7-dotDQNXvRuEidyMmbffuPV2Jzk5f_L7eiwPT4ny9t8f6Hgtiw9Mb1yUlTBJ0As00a2IgLpB1xk7WKU7o5vd9XGMkzE62g4Qox06M4yTjd50TzN6aMiBAq0sTMoOehhbM2kYV91rr9ZgRhS9wkhczva7UOYd1_QpbzzbUI4muZ35VYX-J2AWMF_X1Yb8DLcpYL6rBczK3toImNmfG7Ks_lMlsbwoJRlSqSgzZZSVy4lVBmLKm3xTSZgDSp-jvIdZtjsfqTldfN1RqmYUvdoOT-n3Dv9N5ycAAP__j4Fldw) at those locations, including New York City, Seattle, San Francisco, and Portland. The retailer says the nine stores will close for good on Oct. 21 and workers will be reassigned to other stores if possible. While some critics say they think the level of theft is overstated, store officials say [the threat of violence](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO8yAQhJ8Gd7bWiwFTUPwNXf72SouYJeGEQ4Q3sfL2J1991UzxSd9ovi7LJeSSH7f_YSPHqS5h5fymBWyPc49ywS66RIQkO3KjtsqCHLXs7i5NZoxyHa1RcZRrmpQeYVZz0pGumkKXHQJKsDiDVVKZQc8STZKTDJBWbUhMQDFzbcN3zQ--Uyqf-qY2rHXrirszP3ch_wn0Av1xHMNrD1xj-JyAQL9zbR-BfqsPOvPUCfRgz64Feg7tRtyfHPVrqfur0d5fS9iob8Qhl_60skBvwBppFQAYgb5rLj6PXEretRET3LaQy-8s_vulnwAAAP__1XRmLQ) in these locations is the issue. "_We cannot operate these because theft and organized retail crime are threatening the safety of our team and guests_ ," the company said.
## California OKs Special Tax on Guns and Ammo
California has become the first state to levy a [special tax on guns](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2P4yAQQH-N3RFhBvNRUFyTLtdeaU1giOeEIbJJsvn3q2y95dNrnt6_y3JBLlxvf3Gj0HNbMHZ-0iK9UE4oWNSYQiZSBCOFyfjZS5gMjGuIiSaZrkDWAaKer5PLWqksJ2_QwjRyUFKB9MpJP8NsT8aBshk0oMzRWBq0pMS97af_jWtfKZd3e9J-im0bS1h7vx8D_BnUeVBnvFd6HR_1gb1zLDSoc8TCue2VUdwe9RC4bY_KnVsVHb_EEdfWijgwU38L6axEYwEhaXJztE4b47yNOdmcTR73kO4vLoUPYwctbxty-anpv8_5DgAA__8XmWUz) and ammunition, adding an 11% tax on top of the existing federal tax of 10%-11% on firearms and bullets. The money raised is meant to pay for better security at public schools. Gov. Gavin Newsom signed a second firearms law along with the tax bill, banning people from [carrying concealed weapons](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFugzAQgOGnMZsjcwcGBg9d2NK1I3LMOVxl7AgfafP2VTt3_odf-j6uy9Vz4nx_9zs5iWXxQfhJi5k0jBpwgWZ1kQgIG3KtnfrJYGux2VwcyBrEAbCzrccb9qMN7Rojtt0YqW_YgQE0E4xm6rEfLnZEGCJ26E0MdiDVGVpZynH5LJxlo5he5UnHJZS9SW4TeVSFbwpmBbNstHFKv03BfDsrZ6pVwdwBdIM1OvjEsRyZvabsg1Qd-aii72fWPq_a7_uZWbhkLf5bc9aykQ7lzHK8FMzN4dbHF6fE1Q6qM_fd89-ukf9lfgIAAP__pEVlTQ) in most public places. Newsom acknowledged the measure might not pass constitutional review. The signings came days after the state legislature approved calling a state Constitutional Convention to consider additional federal gun regulations, but that requires two-thirds of all states to agree.

Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c51986786faa4f6b96c49467b5723a56&_e=YWRTv5_jGp0lNgwBhqxcG75RYFljZXqdpOY5ADA1-u14Uh1G4ksBvW7NkRcoYh3vAskJ3ughk49BhPD9LOyjyuD1AwrdiZPDP7MQFp98y3uQtAqFUhUdUayqU7_kVX2S-ptR00vgKtQDeptCNs0EGfGV35YYcsvImwQKRR6o4eHYGGetgQzo-d0cNyuTjln1xLT8ksGLW3rI9OSsR3xZ9BfNqXmDE-r87jQsCwzCs-Qh4KdbkcUvCNw4O5-xq0P-35GBXJGA4Kwyes5vUWMpOw-XPoDVUSmq5Seei6pHm_eolmc23a1imVhKvYXBfZ_xIkTUqJESvRw_3KhSilYCBAKGqL9M4k4ss04yadThnIU%3D)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c51986786faa4f6b96c49467b5723a56&_e=YWRTv5_jGp0lNgwBhqxcG75RYFljZXqdpOY5ADA1-u14Uh1G4ksBvW7NkRcoYh3vAskJ3ughk49BhPD9LOyjyuD1AwrdiZPDP7MQFp98y3uQtAqFUhUdUayqU7_kVX2S-ptR00vgKtQDeptCNs0EGfGV35YYcsvImwQKRR6o4eHYGGetgQzo-d0cNyuTjln1xLT8ksGLW3rI9OSsR3xZ9INQz310Zvk13bHzbJ1BHtkPxYGf5_Dsyb3JcV3C6DGY0IgvvuX57RjHLBmvwjQ9shfC_zpVwL8GUmWIiMELI8opRALM6X5RyGfq_2yOGGjUhEse05xb7RpK6-TlHE3zEC4vMYqKV3si1bq8wG2ekho%3D)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines

name: David Hogg via Blue Amp Action
subject: How we use your donations...
body:
Leaders We Deserve is all-in on our mission to elect young leaders across America, so we’re going to spend as much of our budget on that mission as possible.
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td2f9e2e6-ce2c-4b37-8170-82ec7007c45c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | Hey, Peter, you may have seen me asking for your old furniture a few weeks ago: Well, I’m happy to announce that the Leaders We Deserve office is 100% volunteer-furnished thanks to the help of some incredibly kind supporters in the DC area! 🎉 What does this have to do with you? Keep reading ⬇️ [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9b0081e9-610c-44f5-9005-6b0cda34c9ff/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I asked for donations of old furniture because, to be honest, I didn’t want to spend your hard-earned dollars on fancy chairs or whatever. That’s not what we’re about. Leaders We Deserve is all-in on our mission to elect young leaders across America, so we’re going to spend as much of our budget on that mission as possible. And we’re proud to have Blue Amp Action's support in this mission. [Now that we’re all set on furniture, we’re focusing on growing our grassroots movement to elect more young people across the country. We’re still counting on your support, so will you split a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action to help?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T51613c71-27ff-4340-aada-ebdc765f36ce/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [CHIP IN NOW!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8474c85a-8897-4954-baa5-a112b849a414/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | This fight isn’t just about this election cycle. It’s about changing the face of our government forever by electing young leaders who are capable of bringing sorely needed change that will last for generations. By splitting a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action today, you’re investing in this movement for the long haul. But in order for us to move the needle, this work depends on grassroots supporters like you. Whether it’s $5 or $50, every contribution counts. [Please consider splitting a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action today to fund the hard work ahead of us (not to buy fancy office chairs).](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4408f0d7-2969-4d1d-899a-19d0d32eb24e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
|
---
| | | | | | [DONATE NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9cbfc6ec-164a-4894-b801-38e1d0919b6e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| More soon, David Hogg Co-Founder, Leaders We Deserve P.S. You might be wondering why I was wearing a suit moving furniture in 95F. The day we got to move in I had a meeting at the White House, so in the middle of my U-Hauling around D.C., I had to go to that meeting, and then continue moving our stuff up several stories. (I need to find a good dry cleaner in D.C.)
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
| | | | Cliff Schecter President, Blue Amp Action Amplify Good
---|---
| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Greater Georgia Action, Inc
body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 28 GREATER GEORGIA PARTNERS WITH GEORGIA CENTER FOR CIVIC ENGAGEMENT ON HIGH SCHOOL VOTER REGISTRATION INITIATIVE ATLANTA - Today, Greater Georgia announced a partnership with the [Georgia Center for Civic Engagement](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019VIx2Mul3NtSab3PDA3Du_f-tonTO1uz8NJXlUaRvTzp1UcHNLhy4Jr-equYUY2UoiUSdVinA1gUfnPLxgehVHRa1qOBdfN4RhpccXNaVGIjNbhuh8mxeeEhbaud7eaQDJR_2u55ZrFAXN7Kl4RcNQ==&c=8iRHtQkUxlKdSb4a5N3nGhcFOBe-Kc0ln5ns9priFpjXqSk0Isah3g==&ch=1pI50VSf2joo_RmKovbcYVHWCS4ruX-CkqZv5P3iwOyC1wQetzsYsg==) on a new voter registration contest for high school students across the state. The "Be the People" Competition will take place in more than 80 high schools, encouraging students to register their eligible peers to vote ahead of the 2023 and 2024 election cycles. Greater Georgia is sponsoring prizes for schools that register the greatest number of students. Students can register to vote at age 17 1⁄2 and can begin voting when they turn 18. The deadline for all eligible voters to register for this year's Tuesday, November 7th municipal election is Tuesday, October 10th.
"The Georgia Center for Civic Engagement is a champion for civics education across our state, and Greater Georgia is thrilled to partner on this initiative to register the next generation of voters," said former U.S. Senator and Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "Young people continue to be our fastest-growing demographic and are the future of our country - which is why early engagement and education is so critical. By taking a positive, proactive approach, our 'Be the People' Competition will build a pipeline of informed and active voters that can make a difference in 2023 and beyond." "For more than a century, our organization has been dedicated to cultivating strong civic leaders by educating students across the state of Georgia," said Randell Trammell, President and CEO of the Georgia Center for Civic Engagement. "This school year, we're excited to launch our new voter registration competition - not only to engage more young people in our elections but to arm them with the tools to become decision-makers for our democracy. With the support of Senator Loeffler and Greater Georgia, we're excited to help We the People Be the People." The Georgia Center for Civic Engagement sponsors Civics Clubs in almost 100 school districts across the state, serving over 165,000 K-12 students annually. The "Be the People" Voter Registration Competition is open to high school students and clubs in participating districts. To learn more about the program, visit [georgiacivics.org](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019VIx2Mul3NtSab3PDA3Du_f-tonTO1uz8NJXlUaRvTzp1UcHNLhy4Jr-equYUY2UoiUSdVinA1gUfnPLxgehVHRa1qOBdfN4RhpccXNaVGIjNbhuh8mxeeEhbaud7eaQDJR_2u55ZrFAXN7Kl4RcNQ==&c=8iRHtQkUxlKdSb4a5N3nGhcFOBe-Kc0ln5ns9priFpjXqSk0Isah3g==&ch=1pI50VSf2joo_RmKovbcYVHWCS4ruX-CkqZv5P3iwOyC1wQetzsYsg==).
---
| Greater Georgia, launched by former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler in 2021, is a 501(c)(4) nonpartisan nonprofit dedicated to growing participation in the democratic process by mobilizing and empowering voters. The group works year-round to educate and register voters, engage with diverse and underrepresented communities, and protect election integrity. ###

clean_body: | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 28 GREATER GEORGIA PARTNERS WITH GEORGIA CENTER FOR CIVIC ENGAGEMENT ON HIGH SCHOOL VOTER REGISTRATION INITIATIVE ATLANTA - Today, Greater Georgia announced a partnership with the == on a new voter registration contest for high school students across the state. The "Be the People" Competition will take place in more than 80 high schools, encouraging students to register their eligible peers to vote ahead of the 2023 and 2024 election cycles. Greater Georgia is sponsoring prizes for schools that register the greatest number of students. Students can register to vote at age 17 1⁄2 and can begin voting when they turn 18. The deadline for all eligible voters to register for this year's Tuesday, November 7th municipal election is Tuesday, October 10th. "The Georgia Center for Civic Engagement is a champion for civics education across our state, and Greater Georgia is thrilled to partner on this initiative to register the next generation of voters," said former U.S. Senator and Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "Young people continue to be our fastest-growing demographic and are the future of our country - which is why early engagement and education is so critical. By taking a positive, proactive approach, our 'Be the People' Competition will build a pipeline of informed and active voters that can make a difference in 2023 and beyond." "For more than a century, our organization has been dedicated to cultivating strong civic leaders by educating students across the state of Georgia," said Randell Trammell, President and CEO of the Georgia Center for Civic Engagement. "This school year, we're excited to launch our new voter registration competition - not only to engage more young people in our elections but to arm them with the tools to become decision-makers for our democracy. With the support of Senator Loeffler and Greater Georgia, we're excited to help We the People Be the People." The Georgia Center for Civic Engagement sponsors Civics Clubs in almost 100 school districts across the state, serving over 165,000 K-12 students annually. The "Be the People" Voter Registration Competition is open to high school students and clubs in participating districts. body:
I began this campaign on the foundation of TRUTH above all else.

| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3ojtaclb2g9ao1frpba9n4l13kj4btq3ghagol8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji6coj4cdh2bs)
Merit. Free speech. Self-governance. Rule of law.
_**No apologies.**_
Fellow American,

Another debate, _another victory_. This campaign's momentum is truly catching fire and shows just how much Americans are ready for real change.

I was once again the number one target of my fellow Republican candidates. Nikki Haley said she felt "dumber" when I spoke. Tim Scott came after my business record. Ron DeSantis' Super PAC wouldn't stop tweeting about me.

While they launched their attacks on my platform, I focused on the TRUTH.

**If the establishment means to have a war,_let it begin here._**

On foreign policy, there's no difference between Joe Biden or anyone else on this stage. If you want 20 more years of no-win wars that don't advance our interests, then I'm not your guy. If you want to stay out of foreign wars and make America stronger at home, I know how to get that done.

**Here's another TRUTH:** we are going to Shut. It. Down. From the administrative state to declaring independence from Communist China, I'm the only candidate on the stage who's delivered a real plan. **[If you are ready for that change right now,_I need you on my team._](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zum1qhmr5u79ralb0kr0du9uh7cfit34nb5cfuig_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji6coj4cdh2bs)**

The Trump Doctrine was to put America First. I will take that agenda to the next level. Every decision I will make once elected President will put America First and help American families. The America First agenda does not belong to Donald Trump, and it does not belong to me either. It belongs to YOU, the American people.

And so I know I have to earn your trust. What do you see? You see a young man who's in a bit of a hurry, maybe a little ambitious, a bit of a know-it-all, it seems at times. But I'm here to tell you - I don't know it all. _That's why I will listen._ I will have the best people, the best and brightest in this country, whatever age they are, advising me.

Fellow American, I hope you are ready to join me and fight for the future of America. There are 15 weeks until the first primary election. **[Chip in $15 today, and together, let's make America our first priority.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztv8dssggu1jiiqscnadajhhdl7daqdand541amg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji6coj4cdh2bs)**

For America,

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z59ll5qq9mdua2135t4uego4q433ros8dfvq17n8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji6coj4cdh2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

| [** JOIN THE MOVEMENT -> **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjhn23i1hveu5ihpqook2p3iffe9pcullvbk7ki0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji6coj4cdh2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

The America First agenda does not belong to Donald Trump, and it does not belong to me either. It belongs to YOU, the American people. And so I know I have to earn your trust. What do you see? | | **YOUR SIGNATURE NEEDED: Stop Congress from REVERSING hard-fought state laws that protect bees from toxic pesticides!**[**_Please, Friend, send your message now!_**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2017107?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** ** Bees and other pollinators are enduring what some scientists are calling an _**“insect apocalypse!”**_ Some of the most beloved pollinators, like the fluffy Western Bumblebee, have seen **more than 90% of their population DIE OFF** over the past two decades. Bee-toxic pesticides play no small part in this pollinator emergency. Many states have passed laws restricting some of the worst pesticides – **many of these laws were passed with help from the comments that Friends of the Earth members like you submitted! But Congress is poised to UNRAVEL all that work! [_Friend, tell Congress to OPPOSE repeals of state laws that protect our pollinators from pesticides before it’s too late!_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2017108?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2017109?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Many wild bee species are being pushed to the **brink of extinction.** But the pesticide lobbyists trying to overrule our local and state pesticide laws aren’t concerned about that – they’re worried about their own profits. And they’ll get their way without help from environmentalists like you!
Pesticides can be damaging to people’s health too – and we should have the right to restrict chemicals that are dangerous to our health. Instead, Congress is about to step into our communities and tell us that we have to allow dangerous pesticides – some of which have been linked to **hormone disruption** **and** **birth defects of the heart and brain!**** **
[_**We need 1,391 more signatures from your area to hit our goal and PROTECT BEES and PEOPLE from pesticides. Keep our state laws intact and send your message now!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2017110?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

name: Nikki Haley
subject: I want you to know the truth
body:
I think it’s important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on.

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678189%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KKC8jbgM5YLZivOuk0nmmQ&sysid=1)
---

Hi Friend,

Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn’t be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it’s important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678180%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PKUH3zRiBnmwoNAtz%2bwuag&sysid=1 "Once youâ€TMve
finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help
me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678189%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KKC8jbgM5YLZivOuk0nmmQ&sysid=1)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family’s business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _“Don’t complain. Do something about it.” _

---
| | | So, that’s exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn’t easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678189%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KKC8jbgM5YLZivOuk0nmmQ&sysid=1)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn’t know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn’t have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the “kick-me” sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn’t know what hit them.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678189%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KKC8jbgM5YLZivOuk0nmmQ&sysid=1)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help us end this quarter STRONG!>>](https://secure.winred.com/team-stand-for-america/end-of-quarter-debate-momentum?sc=PRentalTV&recurring=true&utm_campaign=20230928_WG-AUN2.103067_nikki-haley_t1393417-2667&utm_medium=emailp&utm_source=WG-AUN2.103067&utm_content=20230928_i-want-you-to-know-the-truth&ex_tid=20230928_WG-AUN2.103067_nikki-haley_t1393417-2667&utm_content=tv-au-20230928&xunv=tv-au-20230928 "It would mean a lot to me
if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the
strength of my campaign post-debate. >> ")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter!

**With my mandated FEC end-of-quarter deadline quickly approaching, I’m hoping you’ll consider pitching in a generous gift today!**

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?>>](https://secure.winred.com/team-stand-for-america/end-of-quarter-debate-momentum?sc=PRentalTV&recurring=true&utm_campaign=20230928_WG-AUN2.103067_nikki-haley_t1393417-2667&utm_medium=emailp&utm_source=WG-AUN2.103067&utm_content=20230928_i-want-you-to-know-the-truth&ex_tid=20230928_WG-AUN2.103067_nikki-haley_t1393417-2667&utm_content=tv-au-20230928&xunv=tv-au-20230928 "It would mean a lot to me
if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the
strength of my campaign post-debate. >> ")**

I began this campaign on the foundation of TRUTH above all else.

| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zukdcj0p4ssobppii0n5gdgn78e3ongp45uqvae0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji66o74cth2bs)
Merit. Free speech. Self-governance. Rule of law.
_**No apologies.**_
Fellow American,

Another debate, _another victory_. This campaign's momentum is truly catching fire and shows just how much Americans are ready for real change.

I was once again the number one target of my fellow Republican candidates. Nikki Haley said she felt "dumber" when I spoke. Tim Scott came after my business record. Ron DeSantis' Super PAC wouldn't stop tweeting about me.

While they launched their attacks on my platform, I focused on the TRUTH.

**If the establishment means to have a war,_let it begin here._**

On foreign policy, there's no difference between Joe Biden or anyone else on this stage. If you want 20 more years of no-win wars that don't advance our interests, then I'm not your guy. If you want to stay out of foreign wars and make America stronger at home, I know how to get that done.

**Here's another TRUTH:** we are going to Shut. It. Down. From the administrative state to declaring independence from Communist China, I'm the only candidate on the stage who's delivered a real plan. **[If you are ready for that change right now,_I need you on my team._](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ze1g3vmf0lvfo6j0p7iuph27q8729hejnbmtaju8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji66o74cth2bs)**

The Trump Doctrine was to put America First. I will take that agenda to the next level. Every decision I will make once elected President will put America First and help American families. The America First agenda does not belong to Donald Trump, and it does not belong to me either. It belongs to YOU, the American people.

And so I know I have to earn your trust. What do you see? You see a young man who's in a bit of a hurry, maybe a little ambitious, a bit of a know-it-all, it seems at times. But I'm here to tell you - I don't know it all. _That's why I will listen._ I will have the best people, the best and brightest in this country, whatever age they are, advising me.

Fellow American, I hope you are ready to join me and fight for the future of America. There are 15 weeks until the first primary election. **[Chip in $15 today, and together, let's make America our first priority.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zidrpgshag4akl9bf5ji2c37hb1ukrq7g4tcj79o_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji66o74cth2bs)**

Vivek Ramaswamy

---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: Vivek Ramaswamy
subject: The difference between me and them
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vivek 2024
body:
I began this campaign on the foundation of TRUTH above all else.

| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zlbfu28aca5meeo7ohho6ckva07pjirf5ua0dlrg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji61or2clh2bs)
Merit. Free speech. Self-governance. Rule of law.
_**No apologies.**_
Fellow American,

Another debate, _another victory_. This campaign's momentum is truly catching fire and shows just how much Americans are ready for real change.

I was once again the number one target of my fellow Republican candidates. Nikki Haley said she felt "dumber" when I spoke. Tim Scott came after my business record. Ron DeSantis' Super PAC wouldn't stop tweeting about me.

While they launched their attacks on my platform, I focused on the TRUTH.

**If the establishment means to have a war,_let it begin here._**

On foreign policy, there's no difference between Joe Biden or anyone else on this stage. If you want 20 more years of no-win wars that don't advance our interests, then I'm not your guy. If you want to stay out of foreign wars and make America stronger at home, I know how to get that done.

**Here's another TRUTH:** we are going to Shut. It. Down. From the administrative state to declaring independence from Communist China, I'm the only candidate on the stage who's delivered a real plan. **[If you are ready for that change right now,_I need you on my team._](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ztt8bdbus0t66pur9ie8u6ccrvo905qeje88cct0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji61or2clh2bs)**

The Trump Doctrine was to put America First. I will take that agenda to the next level. Every decision I will make once elected President will put America First and help American families. The America First agenda does not belong to Donald Trump, and it does not belong to me either. It belongs to YOU, the American people.

And so I know I have to earn your trust. What do you see? You see a young man who's in a bit of a hurry, maybe a little ambitious, a bit of a know-it-all, it seems at times. But I'm here to tell you - I don't know it all. _That's why I will listen._ I will have the best people, the best and brightest in this country, whatever age they are, advising me.

Fellow American, I hope you are ready to join me and fight for the future of America. There are 15 weeks until the first primary election. **[Chip in $15 today, and together, let's make America our first priority.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z4n2atdufoj6aa5rnubmtchqd78l3ftalneh718g_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji61or2clh2bs)**

For America,

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zn2jfbc3i5hfr6h1rp97h9jijnn3k04fr8697vi8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji61or2clh2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

| [** JOIN THE MOVEMENT -> **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9f47ase8591mch2o4hv78v891rjqhodh5gegnl0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji61or2clh2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[** STAND WITH VIVEK ➞ **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zld50i2aluuvdm3q3kf445ftveimbdid67fvp8e0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cji61or2clh2bs)

**In Case You Missed It:**
**Chris Christie’s Night**
_“...It was Christie who turned in the most compelling performance”_
[National Review](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=f667ed7a5f&e=d0a9afa930)
Noah Rothman
September 28, 2023
...“Yes, the former governor took the fight to Trump in absentia, but voters could be forgiven for wondering by the end of the debate’s first hour if criticizing Trump was all he had to offer. Christie ably demonstrated that it was not.
“The one-time Garden State governor never missed a chance to criticize Trump for failing to show the proper ‘respect’ for Republican voters by showing up to the debates to defend his record. He made that point at the debate’s outset, he included it in his closing statement, and he hammered the point throughout his remarks... But that wasn’t all the former New Jersey governor had for GOP voters.
“Christie laid into the Trump administration for putting an additional $7 trillion on the national credit card... He promised to send the National Guard to the border to partner with the CBP to ‘stop the flow’ of migration, but he stopped short of endorsing DeSantis and Nikki Haley’s plan to use military force across Mexico’s borders to disrupt cartel operations. That was brave because, even if it isn’t what GOP voters want to hear, armed intervention in Mexico isn’t a workable solution absent the consent of Mexico City, which would not happen without devoting months or even years we don’t have to diplomatic engagement.
“On the Ukraine crisis, Christie alone connected that conflict to the threats the U.S. faces from near-peer competitors and rogue states across the globe. ‘They’re all connected,’ he said, rejecting the premise that helping Ukraine resist the Russian onslaught sacrifices deterrence against China. ‘The Chinese are paying’ for Russia’s war, the ‘Iranians are supplying weapons,’ and the North Koreans are, too. Christie is right. Every anti-American regime on earth has lined up on one side of this conflict. On the other stand NATO and America’s Pacific allies, including Taiwan. This is not adynamic that requires a lot of chin-stroking to appraise. It’s painfully obvious where America’s interests lie. If we don’t see it, our adversaries do.
“Nor did Christie have any time for his fellow candidates who had succumbed to the ‘naïveté’ of presuming that Vladimir Putin is a reasonable negotiating partner. The last four consecutive presidents, including Trump, have all tried to execute something resembling a Russian reset. All of them failed, but their failures were not cost-free propositions. That engagement bought Putin time — time he has used to invade his sovereign neighbors on three occasions, and Ukraine won’t be the last. ‘He wants to put the old band back together,’ Christie said of the Soviet Union. ‘Only American can stop it.’ ...
“But it was Christie who turned in the most compelling performance. ...”

-###-

clean_body: ICYMI: Chris Christie’s Night | | | | | | | In Case You Missed It: Chris Christie’s Night “...It was Christie who turned in the most compelling performance” Noah Rothman September 28, 2023 ...“Yes, the former governor took the fight to Trump in absentia, but voters could be forgiven for wondering by the end of the debate’s first hour if criticizing Trump was all he had to offer. Christie ably demonstrated that it was not. “The one-time Garden State governor never missed a chance to criticize Trump for failing to show the proper ‘respect’ for Republican voters by showing up to the debates to defend his record. He made that point at the debate’s outset, he included it in his closing statement, and he hammered the point throughout his remarks... But that wasn’t all the former New Jersey governor had for GOP voters. “Christie laid into the Trump administration for putting an additional $7 trillion on the national credit card... He promised to send the National Guard to the border to partner with the CBP to ‘stop the flow’ of migration, but he stopped short of endorsing DeSantis and Nikki Haley’s plan to use military force across Mexico’s borders to disrupt cartel operations. That was brave because, even if it isn’t what GOP voters want to hear, armed intervention in Mexico isn’t a workable solution absent the consent of Mexico City, which would not happen without devoting months or even years we don’t have to diplomatic engagement. “On the Ukraine crisis, Christie alone connected that conflict to the threats the U.S. faces from near-peer competitors and rogue states across the globe. ‘They’re all connected,’ he said, rejecting the premise that helping Ukraine resist the Russian onslaught sacrifices deterrence against China. ‘The Chinese are paying’ for Russia’s war, the ‘Iranians are supplying weapons,’ and the North Koreans are, too. Christie is right. Every anti-American regime on earth has lined up on one side of this conflict. On the other stand NATO and America’s Pacific allies, including Taiwan. This is not adynamic that requires a lot of chin-stroking to appraise. It’s painfully obvious where America’s interests lie. If we don’t see it, our adversaries do. “Nor did Christie have any time for his fellow candidates who had succumbed to the ‘naïveté’ of presuming that Vladimir Putin is a reasonable negotiating partner. The last four consecutive presidents, including Trump, have all tried to execute something resembling a Russian reset. All of them failed, but their failures were not cost-free propositions. That engagement bought Putin time — time he has used to invade his sovereign neighbors on three occasions, and Ukraine won’t be the last. ‘He wants to put the old band back together,’ Christie said of the Soviet Union. ‘Only American can stop it.’ ... “But it was Christie who turned in the most compelling performance. ...” -###- | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Paid For By Tell It Like It Is PAC. body:
Speaker of the House Kevin McCarthy endorses Tom Barrett for Michigan’s 7th CD | | | [](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6515769ab079b35894d42786&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftombarrettforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D65142c127bcf4150e04448b9%26ss_email_id%3D6515769ab079b35894d42786%26ss_campaign_name%3DSpeaker%2BMcCarthy%2BEndorses%2BBarrett%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2023-09-28T12%253A54%253A44Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65142c127bcf4150e04448b9&l=en-US&s=VIsRFZwkfuxSrx6YSMvH37qPz0E%3D)
---
| **Speaker McCarthy Endorses Tom Barrett for Congress**
---
> _“This race will be one of the most competitive in the country, and a must-win to expand our Republican majority in the House.”_ \- Speaker Kevin McCarthy
---
Speaker of the House Kevin McCarthy (R-CA) announced his endorsement of Tom Barrett for Michigan’s 7th Congressional District, elevating the race’s profile nationally. The Cook Political Report called the race **“the most competitive open seat in the country,”** and it is expected to be a battleground in the 2024 presidential election.
---
[_ _ PROTECT OUR MAJORITY _ _](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6515769ab079b35894d42786&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fmccarthy&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65142c127bcf4150e04448b9&l=en-US&s=nwpjy-Xw3WOTWCgPuaVP4Lfm9mQ%3D)
---
|
---
“Tom is a dedicated family man who understands the struggles working families face each day,” said McCarthy. “I know Michigan, and our country, will be stronger and more secure with Tom Barrett as the next Congressman from the Seventh District of Michigan. “This race will be one of the most competitive in the country, and a must-win to expand our Republican majority in the House,” continued McCarthy.
---
[_ _ STAND WITH TOM!_ _](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6515769ab079b35894d42786&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fmccarthy&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65142c127bcf4150e04448b9&l=en-US&s=nwpjy-Xw3WOTWCgPuaVP4Lfm9mQ%3D)
---
|
---
“I am grateful to Speaker McCarthy and his encouragement in this race,” said Barrett. “The 7th District is the path to the majority in the next Congress and Michiganders are tired of the failed policies of the Biden Administration and congressional Democrats.”“Bidenomics means higher inflation, higher gas prices, higher home heating costs, higher housing costs, with no relief in site,” continued Barrett. “Curtis Hertel, Jr. will march lockstep with the Biden Administration, just as he has with the Whitmer Administration, and take us even further into economic decline.”Learn more about Tom Barrett at [tombarrettforcongress.com](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6515769ab079b35894d42786&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tombarrettforcongress.com%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D65142c127bcf4150e04448b9%26ss_email_id%3D6515769ab079b35894d42786%26ss_campaign_name%3DSpeaker%2BMcCarthy%2BEndorses%2BBarrett%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2023-09-28T12%253A54%253A44Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65142c127bcf4150e04448b9&l=en-US&s=S2GhveeXJqoyv0Pw5hyKbmD4my0%3D).###

I began this campaign on the foundation of TRUTH above all else.

| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z00q31gb305iopkjtgsn5j8nuojrpnjqkikbujjg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh60ob6c9h2bs)
Merit. Free speech. Self-governance. Rule of law.
_**No apologies.**_
Fellow American,

Another debate, _another victory_. This campaign's momentum is truly catching fire and shows just how much Americans are ready for real change.

I was once again the number one target of my fellow Republican candidates. Nikki Haley said she felt "dumber" when I spoke. Tim Scott came after my business record. Ron DeSantis' Super PAC wouldn't stop tweeting about me.

While they launched their attacks on my platform, I focused on the TRUTH.

**If the establishment means to have a war,_let it begin here._**

On foreign policy, there's no difference between Joe Biden or anyone else on this stage. If you want 20 more years of no-win wars that don't advance our interests, then I'm not your guy. If you want to stay out of foreign wars and make America stronger at home, I know how to get that done.

**Here's another TRUTH:** we are going to Shut. It. Down. From the administrative state to declaring independence from Communist China, I'm the only candidate on the stage who's delivered a real plan. **[If you are ready for that change right now,_I need you on my team._](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zo9pu51evrv1fmbaertbhdsdk3om1fpmtljaqi90_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh60ob6c9h2bs)**

The Trump Doctrine was to put America First. I will take that agenda to the next level. Every decision I will make once elected President will put America First and help American families. The America First agenda does not belong to Donald Trump, and it does not belong to me either. It belongs to YOU, the American people.

And so I know I have to earn your trust. What do you see? You see a young man who's in a bit of a hurry, maybe a little ambitious, a bit of a know-it-all, it seems at times. But I'm here to tell you - I don't know it all. _That's why I will listen._ I will have the best people, the best and brightest in this country, whatever age they are, advising me.

Fellow American, I hope you are ready to join me and fight for the future of America. There are 15 weeks until the first primary election. **[Chip in $15 today, and together, let's make America our first priority.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8n7o4lua2at9qfj4kqoijej0a08v7r5f2p1osc0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh60ob6c9h2bs)**

For America,

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcnrm21bvv8kjd8qv4s9albm6ufcs0vqorjgj160_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh60ob6c9h2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

| [** JOIN THE MOVEMENT -> **](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zi89lb0d2q5ac0v6ia8si4859hj4f21e9l6ckgd8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh60ob6c9h2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding."
