| | | | | Peter – I really don’t know what to say besides thank you. Thank you for making the launch of our campaign such an overwhelming success. I am incredibly humbled by the supportive messages, encouragement, and donations from people across the country. We’re building our movement to unseat Marjorie Taylor Greene around our shared values of compassion and kindness. Because of you, we’re starting this campaign on the right foot. **If you didn’t donate to our launch, don’t worry, you still can **[by clicking here!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf75cd782-8a98-4104-9773-198dd9592329/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [**DONATE $7 NOW >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc65cc471-a9ec-4151-b314-3a8df7496d74/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ted1a85c1-1884-4396-9064-aab130581385/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) As a reminder: my name is Shawn Harris. I am a recently-retired United States Army Brigadier General, a grandfather, and a proud son of Georgia. I am running to restore dignity to northern Georgia and replace Ms. Greene in the House of Representatives. Ms. Greene is the wrong person to represent us at this critical moment. Instead of addressing the issues that make it harder for us to get by, she is focused on dividing our country and devaluing our fellow Americans — embarrassing us at home and abroad. name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: The clock is ticking, here's what will happen
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
September 30th is a very important fundraising deadline for our campaign. It is a more important deadline for our country. If lawmakers don't pass a spending bill before midnight this Saturday, the government will shut down.
Make a contribution now to help us reach out goal before the deadline so we can elect leaders who won't play games with the lives of the American people, and jeopardize our economy in the process. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Earlier this year, MAGA Republicans, led by my opponent, Freedom Caucus Chair Scott Perry, nearly caused a government shutdown by holding our country hostage to push draconian spending cuts that would have hurt real Americans including seniors and veterans. Although we averted that shutdown, the result was a short term spending plan that expires at midnight on September 30th.
Wha t happens then? Here is a look at what the MAGA Republican shutdown would do to agencies we rely on:
A shutdown could tip the economy into a recession: Economists fear that a shutdown could push our economy, which has already been battered by recession and interest rate hikes, into a recession that will hurt all of us.
Those who risk their health and safety to keep us safe would have to work without pay: Members of the military and federal law enforcement would continue going to work, but may not be paid until a spending bill is passed.
Seniors becoming eligible for Social Security may not be able to receive benefits: Social Security Agency services like benefit verification could be severely affected, and new applicants could temporarily be turned away.
Families and children relying on food assistance could go hungry: The USDA is authorized to send out SNAP benefits for 30 days. After that, benefits can become dicey.
Airport delays and cancelled flights: Air traffic controllers and Transportation Security Administration agents would have to work without pay. Training would be halted for roughly 2,600 new air traffic controllers that will be desperately needed as we head into the holiday travel season.
(sources: Newsweek, CBS)
Scott Perry and MAGA Republicans in Congress are irresponsible and dangerous. We have to defeat them next year and restore sanity to Washington. Our race is a top target for the National Democrats in 2024, and it is a chance to defeat one the most dangerous members of Congress, Freedom Caucus Chair Scott Perry.
We can defeat Perry, but we can't do it with you. Please make a contribution to help us reach our fundraising goal before midnight on Saturday, and help to end dangerous, unnecessary deadlines for our country. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Thank you for your continued support,
Team Daniels

Harrisburg, PA 17106

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=773%2E552475%2EUGQl4P)
Hi Peter, it's Terese Casey. I'm writing to you today to tell you about my husband Bob and the person I've known for more than forty years as he runs for re-election.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230928-1?refcode=em20230928-1&refcode2=773_552475_UGQl4P&akid=773%2E552475%2EUGQl4P)
Bob and I met in college before marrying and building our lives here in Scranton, where Bob grew up. We have lived in the same home since 1991, where we raised our four daughters Elyse, Caroline, Julia, and Marena and where our two grandsons, Max and Aiden visit often with “Bomba and Mimi".
Whether it was coaching basketball games, imagining the most elaborate bedtime stories for the girls, or being the constant cameraman for all our home videos, he always showed up for our family with love, joy, compassion, and humor.
It's those same qualities that Bob has brought to his work as a Senator for our Commonwealth every single day. Nobody cares more about improving the lives of Pennsylvanians than he does. I've seen firsthand just how hard he fights for families like ours in the Senate.
Don't just take it from me. All you have to do is look at his record to know why we need him in the Senate. He's worked to bring jobs back to our state, lower costs for our seniors and those with disabilities, make childcare more affordable, and more.
But the reality is, this re-election campaign won't be easy. In fact, it might be our toughest one yet. That's why I wanted to reach out today, to ask you if you'd join our team and help make sure Bob wins this race.
**[If you're able, will you donate $5 or more to support Bob's re-election efforts? Dear Friends,

Happy anniversary to former Virginia Governor Terry McAuliffe, who, two years ago today, infamously said, "I don't think parents should be telling schools what they should teach." That line played significantly in Glenn Youngkin winning.

Poet Laureate Maya Angelou, a much better source for a timeless quote, said, "when people show you who they are, believe them." We all believed McAuliffe on stage when he showed us that the Democrat Party does not want parents to be closely involved in their child's education. They expect parents to drop their kids off at the door and forget about their values.

Well, parents do matter, and Virginians sent that message to Democrats two years ago with a statewide sweep at the ballot box. Republicans haven't forgot this.

This cycle, Democrats for the General Assembly haven't seemed to learn the lesson from McAuliffe's insightful quote.

Pay attention this November; there's still one party who stands up for parents. Vote Republican!

For God & Country,
Amanda Chase

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Saturday is a big day—for the country and for congressional campaigns. It is a deadline for our campaign—the third quarterly FEC deadline of the year. And it is a deadline for Congress to act to fund the government. Because of this team’s generosity, we’re on our way to another solid fundraising quarter to report to the FEC. Because of the failure of leadership in the House, however, we are headed into an uncertain future.
In Washington this week, we are seeing why it is so important to elect responsible people who understand the seriousness of their roles and responsibilities. We are also seeing the importance of leadership, and the stark differences between leaders of House Democrats and House Republicans when it comes to working together for the good of the country.
What we see in the House reminds us that the stakes for 2024 could not be higher. And also, that things can be—will be—different if Democrats are back in charge in the House. Next year’s elections will determine who controls the House and Senate and who resides in the White House. We need to be prepared to run a strong campaign from now until next November—for our community and for our country.
And, as you know by now, that takes money. So I am writing to thank you for all you have done and to ask you to make a contribution to support the campaign this quarter if you are able to do so. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230928?refcode=folf230928nd]

body:
We can’t let the GOP undo all of the progress that we’ve made
| | |
---
Friend,
My end-of-quarter deadline is just around the corner. **With the GOP prepared to invest millions of dollars into flipping New York red, I’ve set an ambitious $100,000 goal.**
I rely on donations from grassroots supporters like you to hit these goals — not corporate PACs. That’s why I’m about to ask you to make a donation to help me close out this quarter on the strongest possible footing. **[_(If you’re ready to give now, you can chip in here.)_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70507596/429585501/-2054302023?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4458-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZGQzMmZiMy0wODVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GVpCZgo-6eFGhHPWP7StOp5cSVZxinF8t_ncAQEGrn4=)**
But first, I want to personally thank you for standing with me as we take on the toughest fights in Washington.
Thank you for never giving up the fight to **make gun trafficking a federal crime.** After 13 years, my legislation was finally passed in last year's Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. Already, we're stopping the flow of illegal guns into New York.
Thank you for having my back as I lead the fight to protect **Social Security and Medicare** and ensure that seniors can retire in dignity.

Thank you for proudly standing with me in my fight to **certify the Equal Rights Amendment.** Today, we’re so close to finally establishing gender equality in our Constitution — giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights.
**But here's the bad news: If Republicans flip even one Senate seat, they could retake the majority and _undo all of our progress_. With 23 Democratic seats on the ballot, our grassroots resources will be stretched thin. Especially after the GOP’s historic gains in New York last year, I need your help to defend my must-win seat.**

clean_body: We can’t let the GOP undo all of the progress that we’ve made | | | Friend, My end-of-quarter deadline is just around the corner. With the GOP prepared to invest millions of dollars into flipping New York red, I’ve set an ambitious $100,000 goal. I rely on donations from grassroots supporters like you to hit these goals — not corporate PACs. That’s why I’m about to ask you to make a donation to help me close out this quarter on the strongest possible footing. = But first, I want to personally thank you for standing with me as we take on the toughest fights in Washington. Thank you for never giving up the fight to make gun trafficking a federal crime. After 13 years, my legislation was finally passed in last year's Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. Already, we're stopping the flow of illegal guns into New York. Thank you for having my back as I lead the fight to protect Social Security and Medicare and ensure that seniors can retire in dignity. Thank you for proudly standing with me in my fight to certify the Equal Rights Amendment. Today, we’re so close to finally establishing gender equality in our Constitution — giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. But here's the bad news: If Republicans flip even one Senate seat, they could retake the majority and undo all of our progress. With 23 Democratic seats on the ballot, our grassroots resources will be stretched thin. Especially after the GOP’s historic gains in New York last year, I need your help to defend my must-win seat. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you again for everything that you do. It’s an honor to take on these fights with you by my side. With gratitude and love, Kirsten | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

Hi there, Peter —
I know you’ve gotten a lot of emails this week, but we email you only because it’s important.
We’re quickly nearing our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, but right now, we are short of our monthly projections. Could you split a $10 donation between my campaign and Wiley Nickel's now? Let me explain further: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2309-q3-wn-stein?refcode=230928-stein]
Hitting every single monthly online fundraising goal is critical to building a winning campaign.
What’s involved in a winning campaign? It starts with talking to as many voters as possible. There are also bills to pay – like our HQ office for staff and volunteers to work out of – and travel costs as I continue to hit the road and talk to voters and community leaders.
Some of our biggest expenses are in our voter communication and engagement budget. Next summer and fall, our campaign will make huge investments in TV and digital ads, direct mail pieces, and an aggressive ground campaign to get out the vote before the election. What we raise now plays a major role in determining how big our budget can be and how many voters we can reach.
Early polling shows me in a dead heat with my extremist Republican opponent. This campaign will be won or lost by the smallest of margins. We really can’t afford to miss any of our internal budget goals because failing to hit our monthly projections translates into budget cuts on direct voter outreach.
That’s why your contribution today is so deeply important. It’s an investment into winning this campaign for a brighter future for North Carolina. I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something – that we do love this country. I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A. I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor” because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. And I’ll do it as your next President. As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future. Will you join me today and help me save our country? Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility. As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act. Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. | Peter, Are you a parent who is concerned about your teenager's well-being? Are you a family member worried about an aging parent or friend? Are you an educator or coach seeking to spot warning signs sooner? **Next Tuesday, October 3rd at 7PM, a FREE Mental Health Symposium is being put on by some friends of the Common Sense Club.** The event is being held in the Hanover Township Meeting Room, located at 100 Route 10, Whippany, NJ and Bill will be present for a portion of the evening. To register, [**click here to create a free CommunityPass account**](https://xtz223.keap-link004.com/v2/click/57e971eb51afd95a994b9dd0d28db8ca/eJyNkMsKwkAMRf8l69LHqCAFERGRUnUhupZhGnWwnQnTVHzQf3eq4krBbe7JCTd3YDTScFZAChe-CdGDABwqTRoNT61hqZ6pGPSTXhJAqc1p7mxDkN6_Ln-AbpwM-iIAvhJ6ZLOeTPNsNd8tslXuSZLO3_jPI4bDj2e2nGQLaNufYqw0z87eXUPKrsGuUaF9K9660vNHZqrTKHJ40DWjC5UkbhyS1YZDZasuiUp70CZU-2osR0kcx14sidAU76_keH3p2we9rGrt) for the Township of Hanover, if you don't have one already. After you've created your account, or if you already have one, login and you'll see a menu that look like this:
---
|
---
| Click on the orange Browse Activities button for Hanover Recreation. You'll then see a "Select an Option" menu that looks like this:
---
|
---
The 4th option from the top is called the Mayor's Wellness Campaign 2023. Click on the orange Continue button and follow the prompts to register for the FREE Mental Health Symposium from there. **If you have any questions,you can email[LDiarchangel@hanovertownship.com](mailto:LDiarchangel@hanovertownship.com) or call (973) 428-2471.**
Mental health, often overlooked in the hustle and bustle of modern life, is as crucial as physical well-being.

---
| Our psychological state governs our thoughts, behaviors, and emotions, playing a decisive role in how we handle stress, relate to others, and make choices.
Just as a healthy body enables us to navigate daily challenges, a sound mind ensures resilience against life's adversities, fostering positive relationships and allowing us to enjoy life to its fullest. Neglecting mental health can lead to a cascade of problems—from minor mood disturbances to severe mental illnesses.
---
|
---
As a society, recognizing and prioritizing mental health is paramount, not only for individual happiness and success but for the collective well-being and harmony of our communities.
**Bill hopes to see you this coming Tuesday at the Mental Health Symposium.** See you soon, The Common Sense Action Team
---
|

| It’s time for Common Sense ideas and policies to dominate the landscape instead of the vicious and totally counter-productive partisan attacks that only serve to embolden the elite power brokers.You’re a part of the Common Sense Club because you know that we need RESULTS from our government, NOT RHETORIC. Many arrogant, elitist elected officials crushed our way of life during the misguided, unnecessary and deadly lockdowns. Now it’s time to hold them accountable for their actions, ignorance and negligence. The tide is turning, and today is only STEP ONE!

This year’s elections provide a can’t-miss opportunity to support small businesses and families with fiscally responsible policies, restore an education system that puts students and parents over the radical agenda of the NJEA elites, and protect and preserve our civil, economic, and medical liberty.
We believe that our government should serve the people and provide the expected services that we’re paying for! It’s time for government to function as a public service, not a propaganda tool for radicals.
We believe in REDUCING tax burdens on working families AND empowering the skilled trades and small businesses.
We believe our schools should reject Critical Race Theory and the sexualized curricula. It’s time to empower parents and stop the NJEA once and for all.
I hope you’ll join me TODAY as we discuss the results of this year’s critical elections.
If you want to stand with me against the out-of-touch career politicians who are taking New Jersey down the wrong path and help restore Common Sense, you’re in the right place!Please join me during my show tonight, call in to share your thoughts, and watch the results of this year’s elections live as they come in!
Together, we can keep working to restore Common Sense and save New Jersey and America.
Thank you,Bill Spadea

Friend,
Grassroots supporters like you are the lifeblood of this campaign. Your input guides our strategy, your support builds our momentum, and your donations make everything that we do possible.
I’m proud to run a truly people-powered campaign. But that’s not the kind of campaign we’re up against.
I’m running against one of the richest Senators in Washington — a guy who spent $64 MILLION of his own fortune to buy this Senate seat last time around. That’s not even counting all the millions that he raised from far-right megadonors.
You shouldn’t be able to buy your way to Washington. But that’s exactly what Rick Scott did — and he’s trying to pull the same stunt in 2024 . Last year, he gave his campaign $4 MILLION to boost his end-of-quarter fundraising.
At the end of the day, this isn’t really about fundraising numbers or big checks. It’s about Rick Scott absolutely failing the Floridians he swore to protect: He wrote the plan to end Medicare and Social Security, pushed Trump’s election conspiracy theories, and advocated for a nationwide ban on abortions.
I’m running for Senate to give Floridians the leadership they deserve — and putting up big fundraising numbers is how we’re going to do it. That’s why I’ve set a big $350,000 end-of-quarter goal to make sure we have the resources we need to win this race. Please, will you split $20 between my campaign and Serve America to invest in this grassroots movement and flip Florida blue? I’m counting on your help to compete with Scott’s massive fortune. Friend, can I share something important with you?

Over the last six months we've held more than 120 campaign events across the country, met with thousands of voters, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and we're continuing to build a **SURGE** of momentum.

But, we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

_**[As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter deadline is here in just 2 days.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ziatk1c3o6ihu2mjd8q4vf41sh6p434ej8s0vus0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep77cth2bs "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter is here in just 2 days.")**_

---

I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 33 trillion dollars.

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for President to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

**[But, I need your help to make it happen. Friend, can I share something important with you?

Over the last six months we've held more than 120 campaign events across the country, met with thousands of voters, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and we're continuing to build a **SURGE** of momentum.

But, we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

_**[As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter deadline is here in just 2 days.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpka1vv24cic7jbnkasattqf9mjdr5qqoedaabs0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter is here in just 2 days.")**_

I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 33 trillion dollars.

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for President to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

**[But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you to chip in before September 30 at 11:59 PM?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z374mrr81adsthgc98ees0aphli2t03t43coectg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs "But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you to chip in before September 30 at 11:59 PM?")**

_I can promise you, America is always worth fighting for._

As a brown girl, growing up in a black-and-white world, I saw the promise of America unfold before me.

As the proud wife of a combat veteran, I saw our people's deep love of freedom, and determination to defend it.

As Governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace.

And as Ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard.

Our moment is now - and our mission is clear.

_**[Will you help me save our country and secure our future?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlbqv6aqria5vni2dcfu5oqfc2bumeprt1r3nqko_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs "Will you help me save our country and secure our future?")**_

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zense6h4ffpm6regq3l4onm2b55qf43q3bpt9b5g_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

When we think about the people who have done the most to support VoteVets over the years, it’s not the people who write the biggest checks who come to mind.

Like you, Derek.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: Will you chip in before the quarter ends on Saturday?
body:
We still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrc176rhm0an9n6pbbg26c3rp2b4lv8h0q06rre8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs)
---

Friend, can I share something important with you?

Over the last six months we've held more than 120 campaign events across the country, met with thousands of voters, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and we're continuing to build a **SURGE** of momentum.

But, we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

_**[As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter deadline is here in just 2 days.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zic1ek5on2s2nv8f0vla3drf1c9scsspmki9lbco_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter is here in just 2 days.")**_

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6pkssc5fquk6dpa1telh05pugk5t4rhgvoqm3s0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs)
---

I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 33 trillion dollars.

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for President to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

**[But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you to chip in before September 30 at 11:59 PM?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z61j5u86shsp3lmafvk5j474u0g9dbmnopneedbg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs "But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you to chip in before September 30 at 11:59 PM?")**

_I can promise you, America is always worth fighting for._

As a brown girl, growing up in a black-and-white world, I saw the promise of America unfold before me.

As the proud wife of a combat veteran, I saw our people's deep love of freedom, and determination to defend it.

As Governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace.

And as Ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard.

Our moment is now - and our mission is clear.

_**[Will you help me save our country and secure our future?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0bgdfuiam9j2haj1ufitl1s8h2572iqp2lqahe0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs "Will you help me save our country and secure our future?")**_

---
| | [CHIP INTO MY END-OF-QUARTER GOAL](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg1bfcmadt6hva5un811dfpcc67cimpsg2663udg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs)
---

_**[I appreciate your support more than you can imagine. If you can join me today by chipping in, it would mean so much to me.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0p50sjq21gv5m15s6s0b6me5avlu3o4q7h08qv8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs "I appreciate your support more than you can imagine. If you can join me today by chipping in, it would mean so much to me.")**_

Thank you for everything you do for our country.

My very best,
Nikki Haley

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z746282o88hckd1796q852u3ftofv608mkbcvhkg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjh6ep71cjh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

# Lori Van Dusen, Founder of LVW Advisors and author of "Running With Grace: A Wall Street Insider's Path to True Leadership, a Purposeful Life, and Joy in the Face of Adversity"
---

In this episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Lori Van Dusen, founder of LVW Advisors and the author of "[Running with Grace: A Wall Street Insider's Path to True Leadership, a Purposeful Life, and Joy in the Face of Adversity](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001M8hAw0DlDc0vhSapZf4Wo5-cSE7VOzvcOcYYY1AcSbE6slAQy0yedQ4uPJyucq4xobJgbvbWwWw4qINv-qPLgfgkqK1bK637LP19APziOcMod5tKyXt0weVI6yJbGn0r9rbwt0bUMDrYeokNvftaXA==&c=ZkwdXqIOyG8j3SQ7VYfzwJm6NlOycX5YXMO9jsgQ2Cj-TQZlyO4mgA==&ch=TH-dmAaB0EdB_qdy0TII82x07m6FmFjqIfYClz48X6X4eY3j0fWyQw==)." Lori shares her story of growing up in Rochester and her love of music (and cooking!) and how she found herself at Harvard and selling photocopiers before making her way to Wall Street. She pioneered a new way to advise clients and eventually founded her own firm. Lori concludes with sage advice for navigating uncertainty: don't try to do it alone; find mentors, ask questions, and then listen.
Tune in to the conversation via the links below! There is also a video of the conversation available at [mansharamani.substack.com](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001M8hAw0DlDc0vhSapZf4Wo5-cSE7VOzvcOcYYY1AcSbE6slAQy0yedQpajKomXvUIuLTO6WVQBAwT9fk_f0dQeSbACH6Iy1Rc_inVGEKOeYbzDqEZDq6QcqgsxUqXCYiaqlFAhoNx7ilKmkz4LOV0vjRtSkU3b5Wr&c=ZkwdXqIOyG8j3SQ7VYfzwJm6NlOycX5YXMO9jsgQ2Cj-TQZlyO4mgA==&ch=TH-dmAaB0EdB_qdy0TII82x07m6FmFjqIfYClz48X6X4eY3j0fWyQw==)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Critics are quick to tell you what’s not possible after you start talking about helping working people.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=86%2E4032634%2EmUYzFm)
---
You know, throughout my time in Washington, I’ve learned that when you start talking about helping working people instead of Big Banks or giant corporations, critics are quick to tell you what’s not possible. It’s like clockwork. Take student loan cancellation for example. Cynics said we could never get government on the side of working people. But we got organized and we got it to the president’s desk. Despite an extremist Supreme Court, President Biden has still canceled student debt for millions of borrowers, but this is a case where the rules work differently for different groups of people. While millions of struggling student loan borrowers were held in limbo regarding the status of their debt, the government swooped in and worked overnight to ensure that big banks and billion-dollar crypto firms wouldn’t lose a dime in deposits during their recent bank failures. The difference between these two scenarios? The willingness to fight for them. [**I’m running for re-election to keep fighting the righteous fights for working people. But I need you by my side. So please, if you’re able, chip in $28 or whatever you can to support our re-election campaign before our next critical FEC fundraising deadline. Thank you.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/648?amount=28&t=8&akid=86%2E4032634%2EmUYzFm)

I’ve dedicated my career to studying why families go broke and fighting to rebuild the middle class. After Wall Street crashed our economy in 2008, I fought to create the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to protect people from getting scammed by big banks and corporations. The CFPB has already returned more than $16 billion to American consumers who’ve been cheated. After Senate Republicans vowed to block my nomination to serve as the CFPB’s first director, I went back home to Massachusetts and ran against one of them — and I beat him. I ran to tax greedy corporations, to invest in jobs and our infrastructure, and to rein in student loan companies. And guess what? We got it all done. **But the fight to make our government work for everyone — not just the wealthy and well-connected — isn’t over. So I’m running for re-election to keep up the fight and pass universal child care, a wealth tax, national abortion protections, and much more.** **[A contribution of $28 or anything you can will help show the naysayers that our plans — like taxing the rich, reining in big banks, and making child care affordable — have strong support. Will you please pitch in today to support my re-election and make these plans possible? The amount of grassroots contributions we receive will help demonstrate the strength of our movement — and any amount makes a powerful difference.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/648?amount=28&t=14&akid=86%2E4032634%2EmUYzFm)** Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

_But we’re ready to fight back._

**This month's FEC deadline is a major test of our reelection effort, and we need to make it clear that we have what it takes to defend this seat, help retake the House, and transform our country for the better.**

**Christie’s Debate Performance Widely Praised
** _‘A fantastic debater’... ‘Addressed Trump directly’...' ‘Trump’s most outspoken critic, took him to task again’...’ Christie appeared comfortable on the stage’..._
**A Quick Second-Debate Scorecard** “Christie remains a fantastic debater, and as usual he had some sparkling and funny moments, including telling Ramaswamy to put his hand down. He hit Trump harder than anyone else did, including a fine riff during which he looked into the camera and told Trump he knew Trump was watching. He did a compelling job of explaining the inextricable nature of the alliance between China, Russia, and Iran.”

**Christie Addressed Trump Directly** “Former New Jersey governor Chris Christie has a new name for former president Donald Trump based on his absence from the GOP debate stage: Donald Duck. The quip by Christie was among an onslaught of attacks that Christie...lobbed at Trump... ‘Donald Trump should be here to answer for that, but he’s not,’ Christie said responding to a question about crime. He then looked into the camera and addressed Trump directly, saying the former president couldn’t help himself but to watch.”
**6 Key Takeaways From The Second Republican Debate Of 2023** “Former New Jersey Gov. Chris Christie, Trump’s most outspoken critic, took him to task again for failing to finish the border wall and for adding debt. Later, he looked into the camera and spoke to Trump: ‘Donald, I know you’re watching. You can’t help yourself. ... You’re not here tonight because you’re afraid to be on this stage and defending your record. You keep doing that, nobody up here’s gonna keep calling you Donald Trump; we’re gonna call you Donald Duck.’ Soon, ‘Donald Duck’ was trending on X, the platform formerly known as Twitter.”
**Former NJ Gov. Chris Christie Comes Out On The Attack In Second Republican Debate** “Christie appeared comfortable on the stage, leaning on his podium and spent much of the night on the attack. When asked about the possibility of a government shutdown, Christie didn’t spare either party.”

body:
Team,

Today is Leader Beverly’s birthday, and we’d like to take a moment to celebrate the hard work he and the Georgia House Dems have done to build a better Georgia. Leader Beverly has served District 143 for over 10 years, and as Minority Leader, he’ll continue to fight for the progressive issues important to Georgians like you .

--Healthcare: He’ll work to expand healthcare to all Georgians, expanding mental health care access, addressing the maternal and infant mortality crisis, and saving hospitals.

-Gun violence: He’ll work to save lives by enacting common sense gun reform, like universal background checks, safe storage laws and waiting periods.

-Education equity: As the son of a school teacher, Leader Beverly is committed to investing in Georgia’s teachers and fully funding all schools regardless of zip code.

-Housing affordability: The House Dems and Leader Beverly believe housing is a human right, and will advocate for reforming eviction laws and fighting for tenant’s rights.

You can show your support by joining us in wishing Leader Beverly a happy birthday. Take a minute to sign his card. Your show of support is an inspiration!

| | Dear Peter,

Exciting news!

Students for Life Action has been working with U.S. Congressman Andy Ogles to file the _Ending Chemical Abortion Act of 2023_.

**And, as of today, it's been officially introduced!****!********😎**

If passed, this law would completely end Chemical Abortion in the United States, protecting women and children from the predatory abortion industry.

Countless fewer mothers would be subjected to dangerous pills that could hospitalize, sterilize, or even kill them.

And countless fewer babies would be subjected to starvation, death, and disposal into the sewer system via a toilet.

The _Ending Chemical Abortion Act of 2023_ would penalize any individual who prescribes, dispenses, distributes, or sells chemical abortion drugs and make them subject to a maximum prison sentence of 25 years and a fine. It would _not_ allow for the punishment of mothers who take the drugs.

Our team and students spent a great day lobbying in D.C. yesterday, urging key offices to support and co-sponsor the bill.

Want to get in on the action, Peter?
**[Send a Message Right Now to your Elected Official s](http://newsletter.studentsforlife.org/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cCUzQSUyRiUyRm9uZWNsaWNrcG9saXRpY3MuZ2xvYmFsLnNzbC5mYXN0bHkubmV0JTJGbWVzc2FnZXMlMkZlZGl0JTNGcHJvbW9faWQlM0QyMTIyMg==&sig=GEcXwNXFAnzVmMYt1JNKSyHfo5y1H5gCD2FmgmisnjXF&iat=1695935286&a=%7C%7C649951085%7C%7C&account=studentsforlife%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=SFreolisk8BsbFwsCBzxwsPuj5XtTdhhC6yxe%2BM6iRPeeyDv%3A6FIXbY2hwio8qH3SXsk6wH19Uqy%2Fd0h3&s=e8ce76248dd02de8a72576da08bdf2f9&i=2876A2851A1A27335 "Original URL: http://oneclickpolitics.global.ssl.fastly.net/messages/edit?promo_id=21222. Click or tap if you trust this link.") **to encourage them to vote YES and co-sponsor the "Ending Chemical Abortion Act of 2023," protecting children and women from the violence of chemical abortion.

While this legislation would prohibit _all_ chemical abortion drugs to be used for abortive purposes, the most common chemical abortion method that is currently in use is a two-drug regimen.

The first drug, mifepristone, commonly referred to as the "abortion pill", blocks progesterone, a hormone that is necessary for sustaining the baby.

The second drug, misoprostol, induces strong contractions to expel the preborn baby.

There are many reports of chemical abortion victims being born alive when the first pill fails but the second is successful.

The epidemic of Chemical Abortion must be stopped.

Accelerated by the COVID pandemic and a rabidly pro-abortion presidential administration eager to take advantage of a worldwide crisis, the abortion industry has been quietly building up a shady new Chemical Abortion business model to target young women where they spend their time – online, on their phones, and at school.

And, then, the Biden Administration gutted federal regulations, leaving the responsibility of protecting women to the states.

Our voices must be louder than the Corporate Abortion interests recklessly pushing the pills.

Find out more: [https://www.thisischemicalabortion.com/](http://newsletter.studentsforlife.org/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cCUzQSUyRiUyRnRoaXNpc2NoZW1pY2FsYWJvcnRpb24uY29tJTJG&sig=FGqH3bxVa5EooEyevUdvq9MwWfP7MsmXGDD4D2Zr8NqS&iat=1695935286&a=%7C%7C649951085%7C%7C&account=studentsforlife%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=SFreolisk8BsbFwsCBzxwsPuj5XtTdhhC6yxe%2BM6iRPeeyDv%3A6FIXbY2hwio8qH3SXsk6wH19Uqy%2Fd0h3&s=e8ce76248dd02de8a72576da08bdf2f9&i=2876A2851A1A27373 "Original URL: http://www.thisischemicalabortion.com/. No excuses. Once again, we got the job done. Now, it’s time to kick up the intensity of this campaign, and I need to make sure you know who I am and who I’m fighting for so you can join me in this critical race.
---

---
I’m a blue-collar kid from Florida who worked to pay my way through college and law school in the years leading up to 9/11. After witnessing that horrific attack on the hard-earned freedom and democracy of this country, I knew I had to put on the uniform and serve my country, so I volunteered for the Navy and was deployed to Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
After my time in the service, I returned to Florida, where I continued the fight to defend the values I believe in as a Congressman and now Governor of this free state. In Florida, I met my incredible wife Casey at a driving range, got married in 2009, and have since been blessed with 3 young kids: Madison (6), Mason (5), and Mamie (3). My family is the reason I will NEVER back down from my fight to get the radical Left far away from our rights as parents and the education of children. I refuse to put up with the woke mob LYING to my kids about men getting pregnant. I’ve watched Joe Biden try to indoctrinate children into ridiculous notions of gender ideology and radical critical race theory _**through public elementary schools.**_ As a father to my three young children, I will not accept this decline and neglect of our next generation and I will put an end to it.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._wviusgCXNS5-gK__p_LA)
---
I have plans to rip up every failing policy and get to work reversing the decline of our country. On Day One as President, I am pledging to usher in a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. I will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

| | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-glPQ)
---

---
As Governor of Florida, I’ve made it my mission to lead with conviction, stand firm in the truth, and never back down from fighting for the people I serve, especially when Covid-19 caused commonsense to become an uncommon virtue across our country. We refused to bend the knee to unelected bureaucrats who thought they deserved the power to control American lives, and we benefitted because of it. **Leadership matters.** We’ve set the example in Florida. But if we don’t get our entire country back on track now, we risk letting the Left lead our country down a deeper path of decline for four more years. I believe we can come back from the harm they’ve caused to our country so far, but we have to act.

Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. But we can’t win unless we come together and defeat Joe Biden next November. I want you to know, Friend: I am not running to be President, I am running to get things done as President. **Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024:_Freedom or Decline._**_ _I made my case for the choice I need you to make with me on that debate stage in California. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I will continue to show up and take this vision of our Great American Comeback directly to you, as a Presidential candidate should.

I will never back down from being your voice and your fighter. Please, join me in fighting for the future—because freedom is always worth fighting for.

Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon._That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Please read the following message from our sponsor.

If you're spending a small
fortune trying to reverse your hair nightmare…

By purchasing special shampoos,
creams and oils…

You're probably doing more harm
than good.

Why?

Because treating your hair from
the outside is letting the real cause of your thinning, shedding
and breakages continue indefinitely.

The real cause is a small group
of cells in your hair follicle that "pinch" off the oxygen and
nutrient supply to your strands of hair.

The more time goes on, the more
"pinched" these cells get... and the worse your hair nightmare
becomes.

But don't worry - whether you're
35 or 65, there's still time to "unpinch" the flow of critical
nutrients to your hair. Here's how…

Use THIS cosmetologist-approved
secret to restore a beautiful and more youthful head of hair.

subject: WaPo: Misinformation research is buckling under GOP legal attacks
body:
Republicans are taking their disinformation crusade to a new low.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1638%2E120351%2EYbCnEq)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230928?refcode=em20230928&amount=5&refcode2=1638_120351_YbCnEq&akid=1638%2E120351%2EYbCnEq)
From anti-vaccine propaganda to Donald Trump’s “big lie,” online conspiracy theories are omnipresent in every aspect of American life.
Academic and government institutions have launched research programs to try and stop this growing trend, **but now far-right Republicans are trying to shut down these programs with a wave of legal attacks.**
**[We’ll explain more in just a moment, but before we do, will you please chip in $5 or more right now so that COURIER can fight the spread of misinformation online? Let’s do our part and hold right-wing bad actors accountable for harming our Democracy.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230928?refcode=em20230928&amount=5&refcode2=1638_120351_YbCnEq&akid=1638%2E120351%2EYbCnEq)**
The MAGA Republicans leading the charge (like Ohio's Rep. Jim Jordan) claim that tech companies are working hand in hand with Democrats to “censor” conservative speech. **They use this absurd notion to baselessly attack misinformation research, even though the argument is a _blatantly_ false conspiracy theory itself.**
_Yes, Peter, irony is alive and well._
This campaign is just the latest by Donald Trump’s Republican Party. Their goal is to keep conspiracy theories and misinformation spreading so they can sow confusion and doubt, create division, and upend our democracy.
With funding for misinformation research in danger of disappearing, that makes **COURIER’s work to correct the record with factual, rigorous journalism _more important_ than ever.**
But if we’re going to go toe to toe with the right-wing disinformation machine, our talented team of journalists needs resources so they can continue to call out and counter conspiracy theories in the online spaces where they spread.
**[Will you make sure we have the resources we need to take on the right-wing disinformation machine by chipping in $5 today ahead of our end-of-quarter deadline?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230928?refcode=em20230928&amount=5&refcode2=1638_120351_YbCnEq&akid=1638%2E120351%2EYbCnEq)**

body:
After September 30th, federal law requires our campaign against Lauren Boebert to pull together a report of how much we’ve raised and how many people have donated. That report then becomes public.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70520874/429632495/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNmZjNDBiOC0xYjVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nla08diDD-joX79MGRtDutPFRaUMLeDBMQmOKG1qIk8=&emci=c3722110-1b5e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=e6fc40b8-1b5e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=19445147)
Hello,
I’ll get right to it: **[I’m emailing to ask you to help me defeat Lauren Boebert by giving $5 right now to my campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70520875/429632496/1610638071?refcode=em20230928am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=e6fc40b8-1b5e-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNmZjNDBiOC0xYjVlLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nla08diDD-joX79MGRtDutPFRaUMLeDBMQmOKG1qIk8=)**
At midnight on Saturday, we’re facing a critical end-of-quarter FEC deadline. You’ve probably heard about these deadlines before – and for good reason.
After September 30th, my campaign is required by federal law to publicly report our fundraising totals. Everyone will be scouring our report. Reporters will write about how much we’ve raised. Advocacy groups will take notice. Lauren Boebert will see the strength of the people-powered campaign we’ve been building. And all of her Super PACs will be watching, ready to pounce at any sign of weakness.
This deadline isn’t just about meeting the goals we need to hit to fund our campaign operations. It’ll show the world whether or not we are prepared to take on extremists like Lauren Boebert – and defend our very democracy.
**My race against Lauren Boebert was the closest in the entire country in 2022. We lost by just 546 votes. Here’s the latest update on mifepristone, Peter: A federal court ruled that access to the abortion drug mifepristone must be restricted, pending further Supreme Court action. To be clear: **Mifepristone remains available for now.** But this ruling to restrict is now going to go before the Supreme Court — the same Court that voted to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ last year. body:

Peter - Dr. West has been standing in solidarity with working people all his life. This week, Dr. West stood in solidarity with striking autoworkers in New York and Michigan. At the strike at Ford Wayne Assembly Plant, he called out President Biden for empty gestures: _“I can't stand greedy bosses. I can't stand profit-obsessed owners that treat workers as if they are less than human. I know the president was here yesterday with symbolic gestures; they're empty if they don't follow through. He broke the back of railway workers' strikes. We need more than pretty words. You've got to follow through because we're talking about issues of life and death. We talk about issues of dignity...It's a matter of morality, and it's a matter of politics.”_ \- Dr. Cornel West **The Democratic Party and Republican Party will never deliver for workers. We need a leader who stands with workers and prioritizes people over profits.**

body:

| |

Friend, can I share something important with you?

Over the last six months we've held more than 120 campaign events across the country, met with thousands of voters, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and we're continuing to build a **SURGE** of momentum.

But, we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

_**[As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter deadline is here in just 2 days.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkvnd94b82hasf5v1nr07a01dcd0acjqdfcpko2g_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjj62pr5c1h2bs "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter is here in just 2 days.")**_

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2znqecrkm97vn7i3n9do32o6rhm9idsbgtifhvk00_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjj62pr5c1h2bs)
---

I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 33 trillion dollars.

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for President to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

**[But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you to chip in before September 30 at 11:59 PM?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zalkl8tcbv24u1gkfqn4nvvl0pio3jsqse3h7j7o_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjj62pr5c1h2bs "But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you to chip in before September 30 at 11:59 PM?")**

_I can promise you, America is always worth fighting for._

As a brown girl, growing up in a black-and-white world, I saw the promise of America unfold before me.

As the proud wife of a combat veteran, I saw our people's deep love of freedom, and determination to defend it.

As Governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace.

And as Ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard.

Our moment is now - and our mission is clear.

_**[Will you help me save our country and secure our future?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zava796p8474th2n5m7h0hui89llgvuc77h4amug_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjj62pr5c1h2bs "Will you help me save our country and secure our future?")**_

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmsatva884qkean539bs2vpcdc8bpnn6d6kmp6n8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cjj62pr5c1h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

subject: I didn’t expect to be making this announcement:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
I wanted you to hear it from me and I want to tell you why: I’m running for U.S. Senate.
| Friend –

**This week, I announced that I’m running to represent New Jersey in the United States Senate.** I wanted you to hear it from me, and I want to tell you why.

**I’ve long said that no one in America is above the law,** regardless of their job title or personal politics. That’s the foundation of our justice system.

So when elected officials of either party are accused of abusing the public trust, as Senator Bob Menendez was earlier this week, I take those charges very seriously, and I hope the judicial system works thoroughly and quickly to bring this truth to light.

In the meantime, I do not have confidence that the Senator can properly focus on our state and its people while responding to the allegations.

But, facing multiple calls to resign from leaders in both parties and at all levels of government, Senator Menendez defiantly announced, “I am not going anywhere.”

New Jersey deserves better leadership in Washington.

**That’s why I am stepping up.** [_Will you make a split donation today between my campaign for Senate and the Voter Protection Project to help our movement rebuild faith in our democracy?_](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/53579?t=6&akid=10754%2E878179%2EGQ4Xt-) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Andy Kim and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/53580?t=7&akid=10754%2E878179%2EGQ4Xt-)
---

[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/53582?t=9&akid=10754%2E878179%2EGQ4Xt-)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/53583?t=10&akid=10754%2E878179%2EGQ4Xt-)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/53584?t=11&akid=10754%2E878179%2EGQ4Xt-)
New Jerseyans need hard-working, trustworthy elected leaders focused on the common good and bringing integrity and civility back into our politics. **I don’t take this on lightly – I didn’t intend to run for Senate – but we can’t jeopardize the Senate or compromise our country’s integrity.**

[_I hope you’ll support our campaign; it’s going to be a tough fight, but I know that together, we can ensure New Jersey — and the rest of the nation — has the leadership we deserve._](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/53579?t=12&akid=10754%2E878179%2EGQ4Xt-) As always, I’m honored to stand at your side in this work.

More soon,

_Andy_

| | We are just hours away from a government shutdown. Right now is the time when House Republicans should be getting serious about coming to the table to negotiate a deal to keep the government open so the millions of Americans who rely on crucial government services aren't left in the lurch. Instead, House Republicans have released yet another list of demands that, unless Democrats agree to, they'll force a government shutdown. Here are just a few of the demands: **Slash housing assistance** for low-income families by 33 percent in the throes of a national housing crisis. Force more than 1 million women and children off of **nutritional assistance**. Gut federal spending on **home heating assistance** by more than 70 percent just before the coldest months of the year. This list reads like a list of demands on a ransom note. Because that's exactly what House Republicans are doing: holding our country hostage so they can inflict their cruelest, most extreme policies onto our country's poorest families. It's not lost on me that this is all coming from the party that is forcing women and girls to give birth in a country that has no safety net and no help for the mothers and parents who can't afford necessities. **The cruelty of House Republicans knows no bounds.** I have always believed that poverty is a policy choice. And this is a gut-wrenching example of why that's the case. Let me be clear: this ransom note is a nonstarter in the Senate. But it's also a reminder of the importance of retaking the House from the grasp of Kevin McCarthy and MAGA Republicans. Because if the far-right had its way – and controlled the Senate and White House – this policy would sail through to the president's desk. We have to stop House Republicans in their tracks, but I need your help to defend our Democratic majority in the Senate and retake power in the House. clean_body: The cruelty is the point. | | | | We are just hours away from a government shutdown. Right now is the time when House Republicans should be getting serious about coming to the table to negotiate a deal to keep the government open so the millions of Americans who rely on crucial government services aren't left in the lurch. Instead, House Republicans have released yet another list of demands that, unless Democrats agree to, they'll force a government shutdown. Here are just a few of the demands: Slash housing assistance for low-income families by 33 percent in the throes of a national housing crisis. Force more than 1 million women and children off of nutritional assistance. Gut federal spending on home heating assistance by more than 70 percent just before the coldest months of the year. This list reads like a list of demands on a ransom note. Because that's exactly what House Republicans are doing: holding our country hostage so they can inflict their cruelest, most extreme policies onto our country's poorest families. It's not lost on me that this is all coming from the party that is forcing women and girls to give birth in a country that has no safety net and no help for the mothers and parents who can't afford necessities. The cruelty of House Republicans knows no bounds. I have always believed that poverty is a policy choice. And this is a gut-wrenching example of why that's the case. Let me be clear: this ransom note is a nonstarter in the Senate. But it's also a reminder of the importance of retaking the House from the grasp of Kevin McCarthy and MAGA Republicans. Because if the far-right had its way – and controlled the Senate and White House – this policy would sail through to the president's desk. Friend, Rep. Rashida Tlaib and I are speaking out about attacks on our right to protest, which we’re seeing escalate with a shocking crackdown on #StopCopCity activists. In recent months, Georgia officials have charged over 100 nonviolent activists with domestic terrorism and racketeering. And a SWAT team violently arrested people who’d been acting within their rights to coordinate a bail fund. **This is massive government overreach to silence dissent and criminalize protest. We cannot allow it.** **But Rashida Tlaib and I are some of the only national lawmakers speaking out about this.** We’re calling for accountability and justice for Tortuguita, the #StopCopCity activist who was murdered by police. And we’re defending activists’ First Amendment rights to free speech and assembly. We also need to overhaul our systems of public safety, because there shouldn’t be more money going toward militarizing the police in the first place (which is the plan for Cop City). # Party of the Constitution
---
Over the weekend, Kari Lake attended the Mackinac Leadership Conference with MIGOP. During her speech, she received multiple standing ovations from the packed audience for her honest comments on the 2020 and 2022 elections. One of her notable quotes was, "You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make him drink. You can lead an idiot to evidence, but you can't make them think."
Kari and her team greatly appreciated MIGOP's efforts behind the scenes. She mentioned attending countless events, but very few were as well-run as ours on Mackinac Island.

| Friend, **__**
Tonight marks an extraordinary milestone as we kick off our campaign for New Hampshire Governor! When I say "we," I truly mean it. This campaign is not about me; it's about every individual and business that contributes to the uniqueness of our state. It's about the aspirations of our students, the well-being of our families, the growth of our economy, and the preservation of our cherished freedoms – everything that makes New Hampshire so exceptional. I firmly believe that together, we can bring about the strong, conservative leadership that our great state deserves. But I can't do it alone; I need your support and involvement to make this vision a reality. Your presence and support at tonight's event will be invaluable in shaping the path forward, I hope to see you there - **[Join us!](https://click.mlsend2.com/link/c/YT0yMzEzOTU0Njc3Mzk1Mjk5MjAzJmM9YTN4NyZlPTAmYj0xMjEzNjU5MTgyJmQ9ajl3OWYzcw==.Ks_byB-lyTHS7mPE6D87ZLh9sP1sFmLjcnRk7I4KxB4)**

We are living amid a spiritual war and more evidence of it emerges every day. We saw a full-blown satanic worshiping orgy happen at the Grammys earlier this year. That Grammy performance was applauded by the media and the culture. Unfortunately, some Christians stayed silent, not weighing in on the perversion.

Amusement parks used to be places where children could have fun riding rides, eating too much sugar, and just enjoying the innocence of being a kid. Knotts Berry Farm, an amusement park in California has rejected child-friendly entertainment instead choosing to inject the LGBTQ agenda into its programming. A Knotts Scary Farm Halloween show features disgusting displays of men in sexual fetish gear and dressed like satan. This is the same Knotts Berry Farm that used to host Christian events, even Love Song (from the Jesus Revolution). I joined One America News to discuss this issue, the spiritual warfare happening all around us, and how we are to respond! Watch the clip below.

The enemy looks to attack the most vulnerable, our children. Jesus issued a stark warning against this in Matthew 18: “If anyone causes one of these little ones—those who believe in me—to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea."

No one, especially children, should see this kind of perversion. It’s not entertainment. It’s satanic propaganda, and it must stop!

# Will you stand with America First?
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Fellow Patriots, Despite the RNC blocking me from participating in last night’s debate, we aren’t giving up yet. This election is wide open. Remember: in 2015, Donald Trump was an outsider candidate who no one thought would win the GOP nomination for president, much less make it to the White House! Our America First campaign has received tremendous support from thousands of Americans all over the country who are looking for bold leaders to stand up to Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, and the Radical Leftists who are running our federal government. **That’s why I believe that we can win. But to keep the momentum going, I need your help. We are roughly $43,000 short of our end of quarter fundraising goal.** [**That’s why I’m asking you to give whatever you can – $10, $20, or even $50 dollars – to help us keep pushing through the obstacles the corrupt establishment keeps trying to put in our way.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=a726ade34f&e=0be619cbaa) I’m the only candidate with the courage and independence necessary to solve the complex problems facing our country. If we don’t act soon, America will only continue further down a path of economic ruin and lawlessness, just like we’re seeing in my home state of California. I’ve seen firsthand how skilled Democrats are at ruining great places, and we should refuse to let them do the same to our beloved country! As a self-made person, I hate asking for money. But campaigns, especially those running against special interest-backed career politicians and self-funding billionaires, need resources to share their messages far and wide. [**So, I must ask you: what can you give TODAY to propel our campaign forward?**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=8270b9aa61&e=0be619cbaa) With the prayers, support, and generosity of patriotic Americans like you, we can win this thing. As always, thank you. Standing with you,
Larry Elder
GOP Candidate for President

Service members at military facilities across the country had to deal with the same thing. The Coast Guard couldn't even fund two paychecks. But this was more than just needlessly letting politics punish military families.
No matter what DC politicians tell you, the Pentagon and many facilities that are critical to our safety just can't function properly without civilian employees — there just aren't enough service members to cover for them.
**That shutdown was a real threat to our national security.**
Now, with an aggressive China and a warmongering Russia, politicians like Josh Hawley are once again deciding their personal politics are worth forcing another shutdown that hurts our national security and military families.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37531?refcode=em20230928-3866&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3866%2E614464%2ECWQr9o)
